# requires: wire
#
# 206 answering a request that carried no Range at all. The span happens to be
# the whole artifact, so nothing is lost -- but an implementation that reads
# "206" as "this is the range I asked for" is deriving an offset from a request
# it never made, and one that requires 200 for a first fetch refuses a download
# that was going to work.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:unranged206
run A alpha
orphans
state A

# expect 2: ok state=transferred [DL-R9]
# expect 2: done=64 err=none
# expect 3: ok -
